opening.argument: The speakers question the premise of paying for StrongBlock nodes: one asks why they would give the project money without even knowing what a node is. They discuss token holdings and possible future utility, alongside a claim that participants could bring in six to nine thousand dollars a month. The conversation also covers due diligence and wallet security. That income figure is a project-related claim, not evidence that the interviewers operate a fraudulent node program. Even the invitation to sign up is presented as an offer for their community, not proof of such a program.
